translations: And He (is) the One Who accepts
puzzle.hint: Allah's acceptance of repentance and forgiveness of sins
puzzle.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
